description:
Humanity is driven to the brink of extinction by a massive tsunami that engulfed the continent and the subsequent outbreak of toxic fumes. The survivors build cities atop the bodies of giants to escape the sea-filled toxicity. A lower-class boy left on the poison-filled floor discovers that his master's son looks exactly like him...


**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=850661), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14152453)
